How to negotiate anything
without being pushy
Ask first, then stay quiet. "Is there any flexibility on the price?" Then stop talking. Most people fill the silence with a discount on themselves. Let the other side speak first.
Know your walk-away number before you start. Write it down. If you don't know when to leave, you'll keep giving ground until you agree to something you regret on the way home.
Never accept the first offer. Not because it's bad, but because it's rarely their best. A calm "That's a bit more than I was hoping for" costs nothing and often saves you a lot.
Trade, don't give. If they ask for something, ask for something back. "I can do the longer contract if the monthly price comes down." Giving for free teaches people to keep asking.
Be friendly the whole time. Smile, use their name, thank them. People give better deals to someone they like, and being pleasant is the most underrated negotiating tool there is.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Knowing a bit about everything makes you calmer and sharper in any discussion, and calm people negotiate better.
